title: StrangeMatter.Series.Collection
description: Metadata about a named series. The collection describes the series; member components reference its EntityGUID through Extends. Payload structure belongs to the producing app.

KomponentClassfication.description: Classify the representation and subject in the header so consumers can select this component without reading Payload.

type.description: Name the kind of series; use 'meeting series' for a meeting collection. Other series kinds may use this reusable type.

object.description: Subject collected by the series; use 'meeting' for a meeting collection.
